The SonarCloud API provides HTTP endpoints for programmatic interaction with SonarCloud — Sonar's cloud-based code quality and security analysis service. It enables management of organizations, projects, quality gates, issues, and analysis integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps. Token-based authentication is required for all endpoints.
